t: You're at Oxford Circus tube station, at the junction of Regent Street and Oxford Street, with entrances on all four corners. Three lines meet here: the Bakerloo, Central and Victoria. As of 2024 it was the fourth-busiest station on the Underground, so access is often restricted at peak times. The station was designed by Leslie Green, known for his oxblood red faience Underground stations, together with the architect Harry Bell Measures. It's in fare zone 1.
